Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
My second Spirit grill.  Warranty is second to none and had several good interactions with Weber during the first 10 years.  Replacement parts were always shipped quickly and arrived in a few days.  Then the bottom rusted out, and that's not covered.  My first was an E320, found I never used the side burner, so got a Spirit II 310.  All parts have a 10-year warranty, so I will take advantage of that if I need to. 

The company that Weber uses to ship a whole grill (SEKO) is awful.  Their tracking is not accurate, and it took 19 days to ship my new grill from Illinois to Florida. I order a lot of things on the internet, and I expect that kind of timing when the item is coming from China, not Illinois.  I hope that Weber is getting a big savings by using them, as I will never purchase another grill from them if I have to deal with SEKO.  I would just go to Lowe's or Home Depot.  Weber grills and warranties are the best, and I will remain a loyal customer. I needed to vent, thanks.
Results.Title: Great grill, ridiculously bad shipping.

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
